summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on comparing sensor data across different firmware versions. Initial findings noted differences in sensor performance: the old DP4 was compared to three sensors on a new setup, and one sensor from the new firmware set showed poor behavior.

Specific comparisons were made between the old DP4 and new DP8 (performing well), with the new DP5 showing slight dips, and the new DP2 showing significant deviation, possibly due to placement. It was decided that the old DP2 should be returned to test if its issues are firmware-related.

Action items included re-flashing the 9th sensor on the old firmware, which started collecting data, allowing for a final comparison (two sensors on old firmware vs. three on new) by Monday. Someone updated DP2 to the old 53 firmware version.
decisions: The old DP2 will be returned and tested to check if its issues are related to the firmware.
A final sensor comparison (two sensors on old firmware, three on new) is planned for Monday.
action_items: Someone updated DP2 to the old 53 firmware version.
